name: bead-visualizer
description: Local, single-user viewer for a beads (bd) database: renders one session's dependency DAG as neon tubing and retires finished sessions.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
